description: This file provides a utility class for managing test sharding configurations, reading JSON configuration files, and determining test execution parameters based on platform-specific sharding logic.

classes.name: ShardingTestConfig
classes.description: Encapsulates sharding configuration for test distribution across platforms, including methods for reading configs, identifying unmapped test chunks, creating default shards, and retrieving test run configurations.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the sharding configuration, optionally with a provided platform-specific config or by reading from a JSON file, and inserts a default shard.

methods.name: _read_platform_sharding_config
methods.description: Reads the sharding configuration JSON file and returns the configuration for the specified platform.

methods.name: _find_unmapped_test_chunks
methods.description: Determines which test chunks are not yet assigned in the current sharding configuration.

methods.name: _create_default_shard
methods.description: Creates a default shard containing all unmapped tests and test chunks.

methods.name: get_test_run_config
methods.description: Returns the execution configuration for a specific test target within a given shard index.
